verdict.rationale: Bento claims every release is scored against production history "offline, in CI, and on live traffic" (docs-14), which implies evals can be triggered programmatically. Its CLI claims dashboard parity from scripts and CI, outputs raw JSON, and can read runs and pull analytics (docs-30, docs-32), so an agent could plausibly read results back. However, nothing documents creating datasets or a specific command or API for starting an eval run, and no OpenAPI spec was found (probe-2). missing for 10: documented dataset creation via CLI/API/SDK, an explicit eval-run trigger command or endpoint, documented retrieval of eval results, hands-on corroboration.
